text.description_html:
2-1/4" Sliding Glass Door Finger Pulls

With a 3/8" projection, this low profile finger pull is made for glass door applications like shower doors. Even with such a low profile, it is comfortable to operate with a 7/16" recess with a slight lip for fingers to catch on to.


The 2-1/4" diameter glass door pull is easy to install, with a simple, screw-on design that adjusts to a rage of glass thicknesses. A 1-13/16" hole is required. Available in Polished Chrome, or Brushed Nickel finish.

Specifications and Features of the Sliding Glass Door Finger Pull:

  • Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • Recess Depth: 7/16"
  • Projection: 3/8"
  • Material: Brass
  • Glass Thickness: 5/16" - 1/2"
  • Back-to-back mounting
  • 1-13/16" (46 MM) hole required in glass
  • Package Includes: 2 pulls and 2 rubber gaskets for a tight seal.

*Sold as a pair (Enough for 1 door)
